g.text: 24-h recall (everything! drinks, snacks, bites) → frequency (protein/veg/fruit weekly?) →
money (food budget? seasons? hungry months?) → beliefs (taboos? fasting? "hot/cold"?) →
cook + teeth + swallow + appetite + bowels + alcohol. NO shame — shame starves honesty.
LABS THAT MATTER: Hb/Hct (anaemia + cause hunt — M01 trio) · albumin/prealbumin
(protein stores — slow/fast) · glucose/HbA1c (diabetes — M04) · lipids (risk — M04/M05) ·
K+/Na/Mg/PO4 (re-feeding + diuretics — M05/GER) · creatinine/eGFR (dose + protein calls) ·
iron studies/B12/folate/vit D where indicated · stool worms · malaria where febrile. Labs
CONFIRM, nurses' eyes SUSPECT — order with reason, chase results, act + document.
CLINICAL PASS (link M01 signs): hair (red/easy-pluck = protein) · eyes (pale, Bitot, night
blind) · mouth (glossitis, cracks, thrush, dentures) · skin (flaky paint, poor heal, oedema) ·
nails (spoon, pale) · thyroid (goitre) · nerves (numbness, reflexes — B1/B12) · muscle/fat
SYNTHESIS → ACTION: ABCD + MUST/MNA (GER M06) → classify (well / at-risk / malnourished /
obese) → counsel (Module 01 chain: praise + ONE change + teach-back) → treat (supplements,
deworm, therapeutic feeds per protocol — M05) → REFER (dietician, doctor, welfare, SAM unit,
diabetes/HTN clinic — M04) → REVIEW dated. Red flags same-day: SAM/oedema, severe anaemia,
re-feed risk, dysphagia + weight loss, pregnancy + poor gain, infant faltering.
SPECIAL PASS: pregnancy (gain + Hb + BP + urine — M03) · elders (MUST + teeth + swallow +
loneliness — GER) · illness (appetite + losses + needs UP) · post-op (protein + healing).
Exam line: \"ABCD every assessment — labs confirm, eyes suspect, diet explains, action dated.\"
